description.value: A well-stocked liquor store on the Island Highway in Qualicum Beach, directly across from the beach with easy parking, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists. It is part of the larger Shady Rest complex, which also includes a restaurant and pub. The store carries over 500 international and BC wines, craft beer, locally made spirits, and ice-cold ready-to-drink options with no chill charge.

address.value: 3109 West Island Hwy, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C5
